data_note: Historical demand values are synthetic calibrated indices, not verified tourist-arrival statistics. The 80% interval is an approximate model-based uncertainty range.
model_selection: A destination's committed forecast uses the seasonal trend projection when it beats a seasonal-naive baseline (same calendar month one year earlier) on held-out months; otherwise the naive model is served and confidence is low. India destinations are always low confidence until real arrival data replaces the calibrated sample.

destinations.confidence_note: Beat the seasonal-naive baseline on held-out months (relative MAE 3%).
